title: Broccoli Falafels
description: Baked vegetable balls made from blitzed broccoli, herby breadcrumbs and eggs. Serve with hummus and tomato sauce as a starter.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Simmer broccoli florets in salted water for 8–10 minutes until bright green. Drain.
Blitz the broccoli in a blender. Add to a bowl with the breadcrumbs and mix. Crack in the eggs and stir until combined.
Slightly dampen your hands and roll dessert spoon-sized balls from the mixture. Arrange on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve hot or cold.
notes: Makes 15 falafels. Keeps in fridge for up to 3 days.
